laura: Heads-up — we have a scheduled change window tonight 02:00 UTC for runtime config + canary rollout. Planned actions: rolling restart of dedicated pools, model pin tweaks, and statuspage update. Possible transient 5-10% error spike for ~10min. Need customer-facing snippets (statuspage + short email + expanded FAQ). Who can draft?
ben: ack. I'll own the rollout runbook and can prepare a short statuspage blurb. Can we pin critical customers to last-known-good for the duration?
laura: yes — recommend pin for customers on dedicated that hit <100ms p50 SLA. We'll list them in the email.
deploy-bot: deploy-schedule: canary-start=2026-06-15T02:00:00Z; canary-duration=30m; rollout=gradual over 2h; auto-rollback=on-error-rate>8% for 5m.
maya_support: Drafting statuspage snippets now. Two variants: (1) short public statuspage line, (2) detailed customer email. Posting drafts below.
maya_support: STATUSPAGE (short): "Maintenance: Rolling runtime configuration update affecting dedicated inference in some regions. We expect brief request errors for up to 10 minutes during the restart. No data loss. ETA: 02:00 UTC — 04:00 UTC."
maya_support: EMAIL (customer-facing short): "We're performing a routine runtime update tonight 02:00 UTC to improve stability and reduce cost. Some customers on dedicated capacity may see brief request errors or slightly increased latency for up to 10 minutes while we restart pools. Workloads will be pinned to the previous version if you are on our critical SLA list. No action required, but if you have strict windows please reply and we'll coordinate. — Redwood Inference Operations"
ops_jess: Add a line about monitoring and rollback: "If errors exceed threshold we'll automatically rollback to previous runtime and notify via statuspage and postmortem." Also include link to support contact + calendar windows for EU/APAC localized times.
support_tom: I'll translate the ETA to local times and prepare the longer FAQ: what to expect, how to request pinning, how we notify. Will attach contact aliases.
product_elliot: Suggest adding canary hold criteria in the email: "We will pause rollout and notify if model output quality or error rates degrade beyond thresholds." Helps reassure customers.
laura: agree. Ben — can you confirm the list of customers we auto-pin and deliver to support_tom before 18:00 UTC?
ben: yes — I'll assemble the list and add the pin instructions (route, model version IDs).
laura: ok final ask: maya, can you post the short statuspage snippet 30m before window and the detailed email as broadcast at T+10 after start? Support will hold direct outreach for pinned customers. After rollout, export a token-level cost delta and any quality regressions for the eval team.
maya_support: got it — will queue statuspage publish at 01:30 UTC and email at 02:10 UTC. Attaching templates in #ops-docs after thread. :white_check_mark:
laura: thanks everyone — please flag immediately in this thread if anything changes.
